summary: Validated the new Admin Settings (Resend / Twilio credential management) feature end-to-end. Backend: 15 new pytest cases (all passing) covering authz, masking, partial PUT semantics, empty-string clear, ready flags, /settings/test channel validation, and a blast regression that confirms /api/gigs/{id}/blast now reads creds from the app_settings collection (fake key → email_failed increments, no 500). Frontend: Playwright covered the nav-settings link, /admin/settings page mount, status cards toggling between READY / NOT CONFIGURED, masked placeholder showing last4, save/clear flows for both Resend and Twilio, and the test buttons being correctly gated on the *_ready flags. Full regression suite (35 prior + 15 new = 50) passes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1027 lines — close to the 700-line soft limit. Consider splitting auth, gigs, blast, notifications, and admin/settings into routers in a follow-up.

/admin/settings/test does not validate the `to` field format (any string accepted). Minor — fake key already fails before validation matters, but adding EmailStr / E.164 regex would give clearer 422s.

_resolve_email_creds / _resolve_sms_creds fall back to RESEND_API_KEY / TWILIO_* env vars only when the DB value is empty. Behavior matches the spec ('Saved credentials must override env values'); just noting the precedence is explicit and correct.
GET /admin/settings response embeds sender_email and twilio_from_number unmasked. These are non-secret so this is acceptable, but worth a comment in the code for future maintainers.
Settings endpoints accept Optional[str] without trim/length caps on the model — server-side strip() happens before write, but no max_length. Low risk.
seed_data_creation: Test worker TEST_settings_worker_<uuid>@example.com is registered for the blast regression test. Settings collection is wiped at end of module via autouse fixture (autouse teardown clears all five fields).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new feature lives in: backend server.py lines 200-211 (SettingsIn/SettingsTestIn), 683-703 (resolvers), 873-967 (endpoints) and frontend src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.jsx + AdminLayout nav. Cookie-based auth via session_token. All masking returns {has_value: bool, last4: str}; sender_email and twilio_from_number are returned unmasked (non-secret). PUT semantics: omitted key = leave alone, empty string = $unset. /admin/settings/test always returns 400 with fake keys (no 500). Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/ (backend_test.py + test_admin_settings.py) — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`.
